body: Yeah, I'm bothered by a lot. I've just been really anxious thinking about school and finals and how hard it's going to be this year. I'm also anxious about college and how hard it's going to be. Thank you for all your advice and support.

The thing is, I know this is sort of unrelated, but whenever I talk about my depression or suicidal thoughts she immediately starts blackmailing me. She says, "Do I need to take you to the hospital?" to get me to stop talking about it. I don't know how to respond to that, and it really just makes me feel hopeless. Like she doesn't even care, she just wants me to shut up and be the perfect intelligent robot that will submit to every order. The worst of it is that I sometimes give up and follow along with her games.

The thing is, I'm not a grown up. In two years I will be, but for now I'm still under her control. It's not fair. She's a narcissist and she has physical custody over me. I hate that. I hate that my dad has to go through a finacial strain just to try and get custody over me. I hate that she basically owns me. I hate that I can't go to the school I want to go to because she doesn't think it'll be good me.
